name: PlanPal
description: PlanPal is a human-backed AI concierge for budget-aware Saturday date-night plans. It turns a place, time, budget, and mood into a practical itinerary with timing, estimated costs, and easy refinements. Premium recommendation context is available only after the requesting agent passes Self Agent ID policy and a Celo x402 USDC payment settles; otherwise PlanPal returns a limited plan.
